output_text:
```python
import google.cloud.documentai_v1 as documentai
from google.cloud import storage
from google.oauth2 import service_account

# Set up Google Document AI client
credentials = service_account.Credentials.from_service_account_file('path/to/service-account.json')
client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient(credentials=credentials)

# Define the processor ID for the invoice parser
processor_id = "projects/<project>/locations/<location>/processors/invoice-processor"

# Function to extract vendor, date, total, and line items from an invoice
def extract_invoice_details(invoice_file_path):
    # Upload the invoice to Google Cloud Storage
    bucket_name = "your-bucket-name"
    blob_name = "invoices/" + invoice_file_path
    storage_client = storage.Client(credentials=credentials)
    bucket = storage_client.bucket(bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob(blob_name)
    blob.upload_from_filename(invoice_file_path)

    # Process the invoice document
    document = documentai.Document(content_type='application/pdf', mime_type='application/pdf', source={"gcs_source": {"uri": f"gs://{bucket_name}/{blob_name}"}})
    response = client.process_document(request={"name": processor_id, "document": document})

    # Extract relevant fields from the response
    vendor = None
    date = None
    total = None
    line_items = []

    for entity in response.processed_document.entities:
        if entity.type_ == "VENDOR":
            vendor = entity.description
        elif entity.type_ == "DATE":
            date = entity.description
        elif entity.type_ == "TOTAL":
            total = entity.description
        elif entity.type_ == "LINE_ITEM":
            line_items.append(entity.description)

    return {
        "vendor": vendor,
        "date": date,
        "total": total,
        "line_items": line_items
    }

# Example usage
invoice_file_path = "invoice.pdf"
invoice_details = extract_invoice_details(invoice_file_path)
print(invoice_details)
```
